tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Attorney General may award grants and provide technical assistance to Indian tribes to enable such tribes to carry out programs to support—

children.text: the development, enhancement, and continuing operation of tribal justice systems; and
tribal probation services, diversion programs, and alternative sentencing provisions;
tribal juvenile services and multi-disciplinary protocols for child physical and sexual abuse; and
traditional tribal judicial practices, traditional tribal justice systems, and traditional methods of dispute resolution.

tree.heading: Consultation
tree.text: In carrying out this section, the Attorney General may consult with the Office of Tribal Justice and any other appropriate tribal or Federal officials.

tree.heading: Regulations
tree.text: The Attorney General may promulgate such regulations and guidelines as may be necessary to carry out this subchapter.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: For purposes of carrying out the activities under this section, there are authorized to be appropriated such sums as are necessary for fiscal years 2011 through 2015.

notes.text: Amendments2010—Subsec. (d). Pub. L. 111–211 substituted “2011 through 2015” for “2000 through 2004”.
